description: Internationalize the remaining customer-facing page JS and HTML: cart, checkout, the form-submit pages (contact/form-pages/special-orders), order-history, profile, and a final static-markup sweep of the remaining pages. Depends on FEAT-001 for all dictionary keys (do NOT edit assets/js/i18n.js — all keys are already added there by FEAT-001; if a key is missing, add it to i18n.js as a small addition and note it in findings). Run after FEAT-001.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. Confirm the dictionary keys this feature needs (cart.*, checkout.*, orders.*, profile.*, common.*, contact.loginToSubmit) exist in assets/js/i18n.js (added by FEAT-001). Copy the t(key, fallback) helper pattern from assets/js/products.js into each JS file edited here.

cart.js + pages/cart.html: replace empty-state 'Your cart is empty. Browse our products.' by composing cart.emptyText + an anchor whose text is cart.emptyLink; quantity aria-labels 'Quantity for ...'->cart.qtyFor (with {name} substitution), 'Decrease quantity'->cart.decrease, 'Increase quantity'->cart.increase. Add t() helper and a sugarbliss:lang-changed listener that re-renders the cart list. In cart.html add data-i18n for any static label still missing.

checkout.js + pages/checkout.html: '<option value="">Choose a voucher</option>'->checkout.chooseVoucher; empty-cart loading message -> checkout.emptyText + checkout.emptyLink anchor. Add t() + re-render on lang change for those dynamic blocks. In checkout.html add data-i18n-attr='placeholder:checkout.addressPlaceholder' to the address input, data-i18n-attr='placeholder:checkout.notePlaceholder' to the delivery-note textarea, data-i18n-attr='title:checkout.phoneTitle' to the phone input, data-i18n='checkout.phoneError' to the phone-error <small>, data-i18n for the 'Delivery note'/'(optional)' label parts (checkout.noteLabel / common.optional). Leave the numeric sample placeholder '0901234567' as-is.

contact.js, form-pages.js, special-orders.js (+ pages contact.html, special_orders.html, forgot_password.html, new_password.html, otp_verification.html): route transient submit-state strings through t(): 'Sending...'->common.sending, 'Login to Submit'->contact.loginToSubmit; on completion restore the button label from its data-i18n key rather than a literal. Add a t() helper per file. Add data-i18n/data-i18n-attr for any static page label still missing.

order-history.js + pages/order-history.html: 'Loading orders...'->orders.loading, 'Cancelling...'->orders.cancelling, 'Cancel Order'->orders.cancelOrder, plus any status/empty/toast literals found on full read (reuse existing orders.* keys where present). Add t() + a sugarbliss:lang-changed listener that re-renders the order list. Do NOT translate order item names (DB).

profile.js + pages/profile.html: 'Loading orders...'->profile.loadingOrders, 'No orders yet.'->profile.noOrders, 'No favorites yet.'->profile.noFavorites, favorite-item aria 'View ... detail'->profile.viewFavorite ({name} substitution), 'Sugar Bliss product'->products.defaultName. Add t() + re-render of recent-orders and favorites on lang change. Do NOT translate product names (DB).

Static sweep: re-scan about-us.html, home.html, products.html, login.html, register.html, settings.html, otp_verification.html for any user-facing string lacking data-i18n/data-i18n-attr and add it (reuse existing keys; any genuinely new key added here must also be added to i18n.js and noted in findings). Confirm each customer page loads assets/js/i18n.js BEFORE assets/js/shared-components.js.

Record in findings: that admin pages (pages/admin/*.html, assets/js/admin-*.js) were intentionally left untranslated (no i18n wiring/switcher), and list any string deliberately left as-is (brand title, numeric placeholders, star glyphs, DB content).
acceptance_criteria: cart.js, checkout.js, contact.js, form-pages.js, special-orders.js, order-history.js, profile.js contain no user-facing hardcoded literal; each dynamic string routes through a t() helper with a fallback (verified by grep leaving only non-user-facing strings).
checkout.html address/note placeholders, phone title+error, and voucher option translate on language toggle; the numeric sample placeholder is unchanged.
Toggling language on cart, checkout, order-history, and profile pages flips empty-states, loading text, buttons, and labels fully VI<->EN; order/product item names (DB) stay unchanged.
Every key referenced by the new attributes/translate calls exists in assets/js/i18n.js with both vi and en.
findings documents the admin out-of-scope decision.
verification: From project/src/main/resources/static: grep each edited JS (cart.js, checkout.js, contact.js, form-pages.js, special-orders.js, order-history.js, profile.js) for textContent|innerText|innerHTML|placeholder|alert( literals; confirm only non-user-facing strings remain.
node --check on each edited JS if Node is on PATH; otherwise load each page with no console error.
Manual: open cart, checkout, order-history, profile and each form page, toggle VI<->EN, confirm full translation and that DB content is untouched.
findings: FEAT-002 complete. All FEAT-001 dictionary keys this feature needed (cart.*, checkout.*, orders.loading/cancelling/cancelOrder, profile.*, common.sending/optional, contact.loginToSubmit, products.defaultName) were already present in assets/js/i18n.js and were reused, not re-added. SMALL DICTIONARY ADDITIONS (added to i18n.js per the 'if a key is genuinely missing, add it' directive, each with vi+en): common.pleaseWait (password-reset submit button 'Please wait...'); orders.empty ('You have no orders yet.'), orders.noMatch ('No orders match your search.'), orders.viewDetails ('View order details'), orders.hideDetails ('Hide order details') for the order-history empty-states and the expand/collapse toggle. These were genuinely missing and are needed to satisfy the 'empty-states, loading text, buttons flip fully' acceptance criterion. HELPER: Each edited JS file got the exact `function t(key, fallback)` pattern copied from products.js (checkout.js uses an arrow const t inside its IIFE). translate() returns null on miss, so all calls pass a non-null English fallback. Parameterized keys (cart.qtyFor, profile.viewFavorite) are substituted by the caller with .replace('{name}', value). FILES EDITED: - assets/js/cart.js: added t() + sugarbliss:lang-changed listener that re-renders the cart. Empty-state composed from cart.emptyText + cart.emptyLink; quantity container aria uses cart.qtyFor ({name}); decrease/increase aria use cart.decrease/cart.increase. - assets/js/checkout.js: added t(); owned-voucher placeholder option -> checkout.chooseVoucher; showEmptyCart() composes checkout.emptyText + checkout.emptyLink. - pages/checkout.html: ADDED missing
